meta.disclosure: F1 and F2 are screening folds. F3 is the least-used fold, not an independent one: the recipient count was discovered by analysing the frozen champion's errors on steps 451-650 (which includes F3's test window), the champion configuration E0 was chosen using steps 551-743, and the 1:50 class weight was chosen on 451-550 and compared on 551-743. F2 is the most reused fold. The locked test (651-743) was not read in P1.3 (no labels, predictions or metrics) and gives no evidence here.

shortlist_rule: A candidate (E1, E3, E4) is shortlisted for F3 confirmation only if, in BOTH F1 and F2: (a) the paired 95% CI of AP(candidate) - AP(E0) lies entirely above 0, and (b) tie-aware recall at 100 and at 200 alerts/day is not lower than E0's.
